data.name: skill-creator
data.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends WorkBuddy's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

data.name: tencent-docs-routing
data.description: Load this Skill before handling local Office/WPS files such as doc/docx/dot/wps/wpt, xls/xlsx/xlt/csv/tsv, or ppt/pptx/pps/pot, and before creating a new local document, spreadsheet, or presentation. Load first whenever the user uploads, mentions, previews, edits, or asks to create such a local file, to decide whether to use the local office editing Skill, the local spreadsheet agent, the spreadsheet generation Skill, or the PPT generation Skill. Text-based outputs such as speech scripts, talking points, copywriting, summaries, reports, or meeting minutes should default to local DOCX unless the user explicitly specifies another local format such as markdown or plain text. Other file types are out of scope.

data.name: tencent-local-office-edit
data.description: 通过本地 editor_sdk 实时读写本机磁盘上的 Office/WPS 类型文件——文件打开后用户在编辑器中实时可见，编辑所见即所得，保存用 save_file 即可、不要主动 close_file。适用于本地 doc/docx/dot/wps/wpt、xls/xlsx/xlt/csv/tsv、ppt/pptx/pps/pot 等文件的打开、编辑、保存与新建；含宏格式可打开但宏不执行，et/ett/dps/dpt 不支持。按 doc/sheet/slide 三类调用对应工具，调用任一编辑工具前先用 edsdk.py schema 查它单个的参数、不要凭摘要猜参数。所有操作经本目录 edsdk.py（python3 edsdk.py list/schema/call）封装，端点自动发现、上层无需关心底层细节。触发词：本地文档、本机 docx/xlsx/pptx/wps、Office/WPS 文件、editor_sdk、edsdk.py、本地编辑、实时编辑。
data.description_en: Read and edit local Office/WPS files in real time through the local editor SDK. Use for opening, creating, editing, and saving local DOC/DOCX/WPS, XLS/XLSX/CSV/TSV, and PPT/PPTX files. Route document, spreadsheet, and presentation operations through the corresponding tools, inspect each tool's schema before calling it, and use edsdk.py as the only integration entry point.

data.name: wb-finance-skill

data.description_en: The primary entry point for finance, investing, stocks, funds, ETFs, sectors, indices, macroeconomics, foreign exchange, commodities, financial statements, valuation, portfolios, trading, quantitative research, factors, backtesting, stock screening, options, derivatives, investment-banking models, technical indicators, market monitoring, and alerts. Load this skill first whenever a request concerns any of these topics, even if finance-related keywords are implicit.

data.name: wecom-forwarded-chat-resources
data.description: Fetch the online resources listed in a WeCom forwarded-chat archive. Load this Skill whenever the host injects a `<wecom_forwarded_chat_online_resources>` block, or whenever a WeCom / WeChat forwarded-chat transcript contains `[文档]` `[微盘文件]` `[日程]` `[待办]` `[会议]` `[智能纪要]` entries carrying an id. It owns the resource-type routing, the host-managed WeCom authorization wait, and the per-entry fetch accounting. It does not summarize the chat itself.
data.description_en: Fetch the online resources listed in a WeCom forwarded-chat archive. Load this Skill whenever the host injects a <wecom_forwarded_chat_online_resources> block, or whenever a WeCom / WeChat forwarded-chat transcript contains document, WeDrive file, calendar, todo, meeting, or meeting-minutes entries carrying an id. It owns the resource-type routing, the host-managed WeCom authorization wait, and the per-entry fetch accounting. It does not summarize the chat itself.

data.name: workbuddy-smartsheet
data.description: 操作 WorkBuddy 智能表：列举 / 新建 / 重命名 / 删除智能表文档，管理子表、视图、记录、列与仪表盘，按规划文本一次建表建盘，并追加公式列、关联列与查找引用列。当用户提到智能表、多维表、数据表、建一张表、批量录数、加一列、改视图筛选排序、做仪表盘或统计图表，或给出一份 WorkBuddy 智能表文档时使用。工具名均以 `wb_smartsheet.` 开头，只作用于 WorkBuddy 智能表，不操作腾讯文档等其它文档产品的表格。
data.description_en: Operate WorkBuddy Smartsheet documents. Use to list, create, rename, or delete smartsheet documents; manage sub-tables, views, records, fields, and dashboards; build a table or a dashboard in one call from a plan text; and append formula, link, and lookup columns. Use when the user mentions a smartsheet, multi-dimensional table, data table, creating a table, bulk data entry, adding a column, changing view filters or sorting, or building a dashboard or chart. All tools are prefixed `wb_smartsheet.` and act only on WorkBuddy Smartsheet, never on tables in other document products such as Tencent Docs.

data.name: weixinpay-feedback
data.description: 【微信支付官方】问题反馈。当用户使用微信AI支付/AI专属卡的开通/绑定或支付/管理过程遇到异常或错误（尤其是同一环节连续/反复报错、重试仍失败），主动引导用户上报问题。开通/绑定过程的问题通过反馈收集表链接反馈；支付/管理问题或用户直接想要反馈时通过工具反馈。关键词：微信AI支付反馈、Agent支付反馈、AI专属卡反馈、微信支付反馈。
data.description_en: Official Weixin Pay issue-reporting flow. Use when activation, binding, payment, or management of Weixin AI Pay or the AI Payment Card repeatedly fails, or when the user explicitly wants to submit feedback. Route activation and binding issues to the feedback form and payment or management issues through the feedback tool.

data.name: weixinpay-pay
data.description: 【微信支付官方】微信支付AI专属卡支付能力。普通支付在商户下单后由系统自动触发工程化支付卡片，无需智能体介入；本技能主要指导「重新支付」：用户取消/关闭支付后想对同一笔订单再付一次时，智能体须先询问并确认订单，再将该订单上次支付所用的 WeixinPay-Required 值作为 paymentCode 调用 mcp__weixinpay__weixinpay_retry_pay 重新触发支付，无需重新下单。关键词：重新支付、再次支付、重新付款、重付、取消后再付一次、微信AI支付、微信Agent支付。
data.description_en: Official Weixin AI Payment Card payment guidance. Normal payments are triggered automatically when a merchant order returns WeixinPay-Required; use this skill mainly when the user wants to retry a cancelled or closed payment for the same order. Confirm the order, then reuse that order's previous WeixinPay-Required value as paymentCode to trigger the retry without creating a new order.

data.name: weixinpay-register

data.description_en: Official Weixin AI Pay and AI Payment Card activation and binding flow. Use when the user wants to activate, bind, or manage Weixin payment capabilities in an AI conversation, check activation or binding status, regenerate a binding link, or find the management entry.

data.name: tencent-docs-sheet-generation
data.description: 生成一份全新的 Excel/xlsx 工作簿。触发条件是**意图为"生成新表"**——用户明确请求 "创建/生成/新建/做一份/整理成一份新表/汇总成新表/from scratch" 一个 XLSX 文件。 支持三类输入：① 纯文字需求；② 以 pdf/docx/pptx 附件作为内容参考； ③ 以源 .xlsx/.xls/.csv/.tsv 作为**内容参考素材**（读其数据后生成一份**新**工作簿， 不做原地编辑；由 `extract.py` 统一抽取为 markdown）。 **不适用**：用户意图是编辑 / 分析 / 透视 / 清洗源表本身（应走 sheetagent 或本地编辑链路）； 用户要求生成非表格（doc / ppt / md 等）；本地附件类型不在支持列表内。 本 skill 引导主代理读设计准则后直接写 openpyxl 脚本生成本地 xlsx，并用 recalc 校验公式零错误。
data.description_en: Create a brand-new Excel/XLSX workbook. The trigger is the user's intent to PRODUCE a new spreadsheet (not to edit an existing one). Accepts three kinds of inputs: (1) text-only requirements, (2) PDF/DOCX/PPTX attachments as content references, and (3) source .xlsx/.xls/.csv/.tsv files used solely as content references — the skill reads their data and generates a brand-new workbook (never edits the source in place). Do NOT use when the user's intent is to edit / analyze / pivot / clean the source spreadsheet itself, when the requested output is not a spreadsheet, or when the local attachment is not one of the supported types. Guides the main agent to write an openpyxl script and validate formulas through recalculation.

data.name: tencent-docs-sheetagent
data.description: 编辑、查询、分析、清洗、透视、排序、筛选、格式化既有 Excel/xlsx/xls/csv 表格文件， 构造公式、生成图表、增删行列、合并单元格。 当用户上传、引用或指向一份**既有**表格文件、并对其做上述行为时使用。 当用户意图是从零产出一份新工作簿时改走 tencent-docs-sheet-generation。 提供比 openpyxl 更强大的表格处理能力。
data.description_en: Edit, query, analyze, clean, pivot, sort, filter, and format existing Excel/xlsx/xls/csv spreadsheet files; build formulas, generate charts, add/remove rows and columns, merge cells. Use when the user references an existing spreadsheet and asks to perform any of the above. Route brand-new-workbook creation to tencent-docs-sheet-generation instead.

data.description_en: Create professional PowerPoint presentations from a topic, outline, document, dataset, or other reference material. Use an uploaded PPTX as a visual-style reference when creating a new deck, or rebuild a presentation from existing materials or an older deck.

data.description_en: Create and polish professional Word (.docx) documents, including research reports, academic papers, official documents, and contracts. Use to generate a new Word document or improve the layout and visual quality of an existing .docx file.

data.name: skill-creator
data.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends WorkBuddy's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

data.name: tencent-docs-routing
data.description: Load this Skill before handling local Office/WPS files such as doc/docx/dot/wps/wpt, xls/xlsx/xlt/csv/tsv, or ppt/pptx/pps/pot, and before creating a new local document, spreadsheet, or presentation. Load first whenever the user uploads, mentions, previews, edits, or asks to create such a local file, to decide whether to use the local office editing Skill, the local spreadsheet agent, the spreadsheet generation Skill, or the PPT Skill (`tencent-pptx` for generate / understand / edit). Text-based outputs such as speech scripts, talking points, copywriting, summaries, reports, or meeting minutes should default to local DOCX unless the user explicitly specifies another local format such as markdown or plain text. Other file types are out of scope.

data.name: tencent-local-office-edit
data.description: 通过本地 editor_sdk 实时读写本机磁盘上的 Office/WPS 类型文件——文件打开后用户在编辑器中实时可见，编辑所见即所得，保存用 save_file 即可、不要主动 close_file。适用于本地 doc/docx/dot/wps/wpt、xls/xlsx/xlt/csv/tsv、ppt/pptx/pps/pot 等文件的打开、编辑、保存与新建；含宏格式可打开但宏不执行，et/ett/dps/dpt 不支持。按 doc/sheet/slide 三类调用对应工具，调用任一编辑工具前先用 edsdk.py schema 查它单个的参数、不要凭摘要猜参数。所有操作经本目录 edsdk.py（python3 edsdk.py list/schema/call）封装，端点自动发现、上层无需关心底层细节。触发词：本地文档、本机 docx/xlsx/pptx/wps、Office/WPS 文件、editor_sdk、edsdk.py、本地编辑、实时编辑。
data.description_en: Read and edit local Office/WPS files in real time through the local editor SDK. Use for opening, creating, editing, and saving local DOC/DOCX/WPS, XLS/XLSX/CSV/TSV, and PPT/PPTX files. Route document, spreadsheet, and presentation operations through the corresponding tools, inspect each tool's schema before calling it, and use edsdk.py as the only integration entry point.

data.name: wecom-forwarded-chat-resources
data.description: Fetch the online resources listed in a WeCom forwarded-chat archive. Load this Skill whenever the host injects a `<wecom_forwarded_chat_online_resources>` block, or whenever a WeCom / WeChat forwarded-chat transcript contains `[文档]` `[微盘文件]` `[日程]` `[待办]` `[会议]` `[智能纪要]` entries carrying an id. data.description_en: Fetch the online resources listed in a WeCom forwarded-chat archive. Load this Skill whenever the host injects a <wecom_forwarded_chat_online_resources> block, or whenever a WeCom / WeChat forwarded-chat transcript contains document, WeDrive file, calendar, todo, meeting, or meeting-minutes entries carrying an id. It owns the resource-type routing, the host-managed WeCom authorization wait, and the per-entry fetch accounting. It does not summarize the chat itself.

data.description_en: The primary entry point for finance, investing, stocks, funds, ETFs, sectors, indices, macroeconomics, foreign exchange, commodities, financial statements, valuation, portfolios, trading, quantitative research, factors, backtesting, stock screening, options, derivatives, investment-banking models, technical indicators, market monitoring, and alerts. Load this skill first whenever a request concerns any of these topics, even if finance-related keywords are implicit.

data.name: weixinpay-feedback
data.description: 【微信支付官方】问题反馈。当用户使用微信AI支付/AI专属卡的开通/绑定或支付/管理过程遇到异常或错误（尤其是同一环节连续/反复报错、重试仍失败），主动引导用户上报问题。开通/绑定过程的问题通过反馈收集表链接反馈；支付/管理问题或用户直接想要反馈时通过工具反馈。关键词：微信AI支付反馈、Agent支付反馈、AI专属卡反馈、微信支付反馈。
data.description_en: Official Weixin Pay issue-reporting flow. Use when activation, binding, payment, or management of Weixin AI Pay or the AI Payment Card repeatedly fails, or when the user explicitly wants to submit feedback. Route activation and binding issues to the feedback form and payment or management issues through the feedback tool.

data.name: weixinpay-pay
data.description: 【微信支付官方】微信支付AI专属卡支付能力。普通支付在商户下单后由系统自动触发工程化支付卡片，无需智能体介入；本技能主要指导「重新支付」：用户取消/关闭支付后想对同一笔订单再付一次时，智能体须先询问并确认订单，再将该订单上次支付所用的 WeixinPay-Required 值作为 paymentCode 调用 mcp__weixinpay__weixinpay_retry_pay 重新触发支付，无需重新下单。关键词：重新支付、再次支付、重新付款、重付、取消后再付一次、微信AI支付、微信Agent支付。
data.description_en: Official Weixin AI Payment Card payment guidance. Normal payments are triggered automatically when a merchant order returns WeixinPay-Required; use this skill mainly when the user wants to retry a cancelled or closed payment for the same order. Confirm the order, then reuse that order's previous WeixinPay-Required value as paymentCode to trigger the retry without creating a new order.

data.name: weixinpay-register
data.description: 【微信支付官方】用于用户开通/绑定微信AI支付或者AI专属卡功能，或查询开通/绑定状态。用于用户要开通、绑定、激活在 AI 对话中使用微信支付的能力。也用于回答用户"我是否已开通、如何查看或管理微信AI支付"等开通状态咨询。关键词：微信支付AI专属卡、微信AI支付、开通微信支付、绑定微信支付、激活AI支付、开通/绑定AI专属卡、绑定智能体钱包、是否开通AI支付、是否开通AI专属卡、查询开通状态、管理AI支付、管理AI专属卡。
data.description_en: Official Weixin AI Pay and AI Payment Card activation and binding flow. Use when the user wants to activate, bind, or manage Weixin payment capabilities in an AI conversation, check activation or binding status, regenerate a binding link, or find the management entry.

data.name: tencent-docs-sheet-generation
data.description: 生成一份全新的 Excel/xlsx 工作簿。触发条件是**意图为"生成新表"**——用户明确请求 "创建/生成/新建/做一份/整理成一份新表/汇总成新表/from scratch" 一个 XLSX 文件。 支持三类输入：① 纯文字需求；② 以 pdf/docx/pptx 附件作为内容参考； ③ 以源 .xlsx/.xls/.csv/.tsv 作为**内容参考素材**（读其数据后生成一份**新**工作簿， 不做原地编辑；由 `extract.py` 统一抽取为 markdown）。 **不适用**：用户意图是编辑 / 分析 / 透视 / 清洗源表本身（应走 sheetagent 或本地编辑链路）； 用户要求生成非表格（doc / ppt / md 等）；本地附件类型不在支持列表内。 本 skill 引导主代理读设计准则后直接写 openpyxl 脚本生成本地 xlsx，并用 recalc 校验公式零错误。
data.description_en: Create a brand-new Excel/XLSX workbook. The trigger is the user's intent to PRODUCE a new spreadsheet (not to edit an existing one). Accepts three kinds of inputs: (1) text-only requirements, (2) PDF/DOCX/PPTX attachments as content references, and (3) source .xlsx/.xls/.csv/.tsv files used solely as content references — the skill reads their data and generates a brand-new workbook (never edits the source in place). Do NOT use when the user's intent is to edit / analyze / pivot / clean the source spreadsheet itself, when the requested output is not a spreadsheet, or when the local attachment is not one of the supported types. Guides the main agent to write an openpyxl script and validate formulas through recalculation.

data.name: tencent-docs-sheetagent
data.description: 编辑、查询、分析、清洗、透视、排序、筛选、格式化既有 Excel/xlsx/xls/csv 表格文件， 构造公式、生成图表、增删行列、合并单元格。 当用户上传、引用或指向一份**既有**表格文件、并对其做上述行为时使用。 当用户意图是从零产出一份新工作簿时改走 tencent-docs-sheet-generation。 提供比 openpyxl 更强大的表格处理能力。
data.description_en: Edit, query, analyze, clean, pivot, sort, filter, and format existing Excel/xlsx/xls/csv spreadsheet files; build formulas, generate charts, add/remove rows and columns, merge cells. Use when the user references an existing spreadsheet and asks to perform any of the above. Route brand-new-workbook creation to tencent-docs-sheet-generation instead.

data.name: tencent-pptx
data.description: 创建、理解与编辑专业的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。适用于根据主题、大纲、文档、数据或参考材料生成完整 .pptx；读懂已有 PPT 并回答关于它的问题（某一页讲什么、全文结构等）；以及对已有 pptx 改标题、改某一页、增删页等编辑。触发词：做PPT、生成PPT、改PPT、看这份PPT、这一页讲什么、pptx、幻灯片。
data.description_en: Create, understand, and edit professional PowerPoint presentations. Generate a complete .pptx from a topic, outline, document, dataset, or reference material; answer questions about an existing deck (what a slide says, overall structure); and edit an existing pptx (titles, a specific page, add/remove slides). Triggers: make PPT, generate PPT, edit PPT, look at this PPT, what this slide says, pptx, slides.

data.name: tencent-docx
data.description: 专业 Word 文档（.docx）创作与美化助手。用于生成研报、论文、公文、合同等垂类专业 Word 文档，或对已有 .docx 进行排版美化。当用户需要写文档、生成 Word、排版或美化 .docx 时调用。
data.description_en: Create and polish professional Word (.docx) documents, including research reports, academic papers, official documents, and contracts. Use to generate a new Word document or improve the layout and visual quality of an existing .docx file.

data.name: agent-browser

This skill uses the open source vercel-labs/agent-browser CLI and supports macOS, Linux, and Windows x64.

data.name: neodata-financial-search
data.description: NeoData Financial Search — 自然语言通用金融数据搜索服务。用自然语言查询股票、基金、指数、板块、 债券、期货、期权、宏观经济、外汇、大宗商品等全品类金融数据，涵盖行情报价、财务报表（财报）、 资金流向、研报评级、舆情观点、事件公告等，支持结构化API数据和财经文章两种召回模式，即问即答。 Use when the user asks about financial data, stock quotes, financial statements, earnings reports, market data, fund info, bonds, futures, options, macro economics, forex, commodities, research reports, or needs to query the NeoData API.
data.description_zh: 自然语言查询股票、基金、指数、板块、债券、期货、期权、宏观、外汇、大宗商品等全品类金融数据
data.description_en: Natural language financial data search (stocks, funds, indices, bonds, futures, options, macro, forex, commodities)

data.name: westock-data
data.description: 金融市场结构化数据查询的权威入口。支持股票（A股/港股/美股/日韩股）、ETF、指数、板块、期货、外汇、可转债的行情、财报、研报、新闻、公告、事件、股东、分红、ETF持仓、热搜榜、新股/投资日历、龙虎榜等数据查询；同时支持产业链图谱、行业经营数据、申万行业估值/盈利预测/财务、全球宏观经济等数据查询；不同标的与市场支持的维度不同，具体命令与能力差异见 references/routing-guide.md。命中能力域时禁止 web_search、HTTP 直连或其它金融 Skill 替代；筛股用 westock-screener。

data.name: westock-tool
data.description: 选股 / 选基工具——按条件、策略、标签、事件、排行从全市场批量筛选股票或 ETF。当用户问"找一只 / 哪些股票 / 帮我选 / 推荐 / 排行榜 / TOP / 筛选 / MACD金叉 / 央企股 / ST股 / 高股息ETF"时使用。提供 filter（自定义条件）、strategy（预置策略）、label（标签/ETF主题）、event（事件触发）、ranking（排行，支持在板块/标签/策略/事件结果内二次排序）等入口。本技能只做"批量筛选"；查单只标的详细数据用 westock-data。
